cards.name: Boltund

cards.name: Bramblin

cards.name: Flittle

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.

abilities.name: Stellar Veil

cards.name: Gimmighoul

attacks.name: Call for Family

cards.name: Loudred

attacks.name: Body Slam

cards.flavorText: The force of this Pokémon's loud voice isn't just the sound—it's also the wave of air pressure that blows opponents away and damages them.

cards.name: Bounsweet

attacks.name: Quick Blow
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its sweat is sweet, like syrup made from boiled- down fruit. Because of this, Bounsweet was highly valued in the past, when sweeteners were scarce.

cards.name: Toedscool

attacks.name: Clinging Spore

cards.name: Porygon2

cards.name: Arboliva

cards.name: Lunatone

cards.name: Skarmory

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.name: Herdier
cards.flavorText: The black fur that covers this Pokémon's body is dense and springy. Even sharp fangs bounce right off.

cards.name: Steenee

cards.flavorText: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

cards.name: Eevee

attacks.name: Cheer Up

cards.name: Bunnelby

attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

cards.name: Phantump

cards.name: Audino

cards.name: Salandit

cards.name: Veluza

attacks.name: Slim Screw
attacks.text: If you have no cards in your hand, this attack can be used for Water.

cards.flavorText: When Veluza discards unnecessary flesh, its mind becomes honed and its psychic power increases. The spare flesh has a mild but delicious flavor.

cards.name: Sableye

attacks.name: Night Eyes
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Unseen Claw
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, this attack does 70 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

cards.name: Oricorio

abilities.name: Ardent Dancing
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may heal 20 damage from your Active Evolution Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is incredibly popular, possibly because its passionate dancing is a great match with the temperament of Paldean people.

cards.name: Weavile

abilities.name: Assaulting Hunt
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when this Pokémon moves from your Bench to the Active Spot, you may switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Basic Pokémon to the Active Spot.

cards.flavorText: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.

cards.name: Rabsca

attacks.name: Revival Blessing
attacks.text: Put a Pokémon from your discard pile onto your Bench.

attacks.name: Psybeam
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.

cards.name: Vespiquen

attacks.name: Double Stab
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Order a Raid
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your Benched Combee and shuffle that Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck. If you can't shuffle a Combee into your deck, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It houses its colony in cells in its body and releases various pheromones to make those grubs do its bidding.

cards.name: Passimian

attacks.name: Make the Assist
attacks.text: Move an Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon battles by throwing hard berries. It won't obey a Trainer who throws Poké Balls without skill.

cards.name: Calamitous Wasteland
rules: The Retreat Cost of each Basic non-Fighting Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) is Colorless more.
You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.

cards.name: Cetitan

attacks.name: Special Horn
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Special Energy attached, this attack does 140 more damage.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon wanders around snowy, icy areas. It protects its body with powerful muscles and a thick layer of fat under its skin.

cards.name: Delivery Drone
rules: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

cards.name: Corviknight

attacks.name: Accelerate
attacks.text: If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from this attack, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Spinning Bird
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Corviknight can't serve as a taxi service in Paldea because the Pokémon's natural predators will attack it while it flies, endangering the customer.

cards.name: Skiploom

abilities.name: Drifting Dodge
abilities.text: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.

attacks.name: Flowery Zephyr
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Skiploom enthusiasts can apparently tell where a Skiploom was born by the scent drifting from the flower on the Pokémon's head.

cards.name: Brambleghast

attacks.name: Absorb Life
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dead Wood Detention
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, attacks that the Defending Pokémon uses cost ColorlessColorless more.

cards.flavorText: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.

cards.name: Pelipper

abilities.name: Hearsay
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may choose 1: put a Supporter card from your discard pile into your hand; or search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, put it into your hand, and then shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon in its beak. It bobs on the waves to rest its wings.

cards.name: Farigiraf

attacks.name: Either Face
attacks.text: Choose a player. That player shuffles their hand into their deck and draws 4 cards.

cards.flavorText: Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig's.

cards.name: Maushold

attacks.name: Gnaw Relentlessly
attacks.text: Put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Pokémon for each of your Maushold in play.

cards.flavorText: They build huge nests with many rooms that are used for different purposes, such as eating and sleeping.

cards.name: Choice Belt
rules: The attacks of the Pokémon this card is attached to do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon V (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

cards.name: Glimmet

attacks.name: Ascension
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.

cards.name: Delibird

attacks.name: Double Draw
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

cards.flavorText: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.

cards.name: Bramblin

attacks.name: Ride the Wind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

cards.name: Bramblin

attacks.name: Blot
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

cards.name: Tropius

attacks.name: Leaf Drain
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Tropic Breeze
attacks.text: Move all Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows twice a year.

cards.name: Pincurchin

attacks.name: Needle Crush
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon generates electricity when it digests food. It uses its five hard teeth to scrape seaweed off surfaces and eat it.

cards.name: Pineco
cards.flavorText: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

cards.name: Charcadet
cards.flavorText: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

cards.name: Tadbulb
cards.flavorText: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

cards.name: Magnemite

attacks.name: Magnetic Charge
attacks.text: Attach up to 2 Basic Lightning Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

cards.name: Wo-Chien ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Covetous Ivy
attacks.text: This attack does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon for each Prize card your opponent has taken. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Skeledirge ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Vitality Song
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from each of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Burning Voice
attacks.text: This attack does 10 less damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

cards.name: Frigibax
cards.flavorText: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.

cards.name: Baxcalibur

abilities.name: Super Cold
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a Basic Water Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.

cards.name: Crocalor
cards.flavorText: The combination of Crocalor's fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon's head.

cards.name: Clavell
rules: Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Pokémon with 120 HP or less, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Chi-Yu ex

attacks.name: Jealously Singe
attacks.text: Discard the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Flame Surge
attacks.text: Choose up to 3 of your Benched Pokémon. For each of those Pokémon, search your deck for a Basic Fire Energy card and attach it to that Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Grusha
rules: Draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand. If none of your Pokémon have any Energy attached, draw cards until you have 7 cards in your hand instead.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Chien-Pao ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Shivery Chill
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may search your deck for up to 2 Basic Water Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Hail Blade
attacks.text: You may discard any amount of Water Energy from your Pokémon. This attack does 60 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

cards.name: Hawlucha

abilities.name: Flying Entry
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may choose 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and put 1 damage counter on each of them.

cards.flavorText: Its elegant finishing moves—performed by nimbly leaping around using its wings—are polished in the forest where it was born and raised.

cards.name: Annihilape

attacks.name: Rage Fist
attacks.text: This attack does 70 damage for each Prize card your opponent has taken.

attacks.name: Dynamite Punch
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.

cards.name: Professor's Research (Professor Sada)
rules: Discard your hand and draw 7 cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Koraidon

attacks.name: Rampaging Fang
attacks.text: Discard 3 Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.

cards.name: Kingambit

abilities.name: Leadership
abilities.text: Your Basic Pokémon's attacks do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.

cards.name: Rock Chestplate
rules: The Fighting Pokémon this card is attached to takes 30 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

cards.name: Picnic Basket
rules: Heal 30 damage from each Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

cards.name: Sandaconda

attacks.name: Sandstorm Spray
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. If you discarded any Energy in this way, your opponent shuffles their Active Pokémon and all attached cards into their deck.

cards.flavorText: It will expand its body as much as it can and then contract itself, blasting out sand with enough force to wash away a dump truck.

cards.name: Zangoose

attacks.name: Drag Off
attacks.text: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. This attack does 30 damage to the new Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It's Seviper's archrival. To threaten those it encounters, it fans out the claws on its front paws.

cards.name: Quaxwell
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.

cards.name: Vivillon

attacks.name: Miracle Powder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose a Special Condition. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now affected by that Special Condition.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was born in a land where flowers bloom. It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its wings during battle.

cards.name: Dachsbun

abilities.name: Well-Baked Body
abilities.text: This Pokémon can't be Burned. Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Fire Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon's body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.

cards.name: Scovillain

attacks.name: Hot Bite
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Super Spicy Breath
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Fire Energy attached, this attack does 90 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

cards.name: Nest Ball
rules: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

cards.name: Heracross

attacks.name: Superpowered Throw
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

cards.flavorText: With its herculean powers, it can easily throw around an object that is 100 times its own weight.

cards.name: Beach Court
rules: The Retreat Cost of each Basic Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) is Colorless less.
You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.

cards.name: Magneton

attacks.name: Explosion
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 90 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: They're formed by several Magnemite linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.

cards.name: Smoliv

attacks.name: Nutrients
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.flavorText: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.

cards.name: Capsakid

attacks.name: Increasing Spice
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Fire Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.

cards.name: Bruxish

attacks.name: Vivid Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It grinds its teeth with great force to stimulate its brain. It fires the psychic energy created by this process from the protuberance on its head.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

cards.name: Rotom

attacks.name: Linear Attack
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.

cards.name: Pokégear 3.0
rules: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Supporter card you find there and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

cards.name: Meditite

attacks.name: Feint
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

cards.flavorText: It never skips its daily yoga training. It heightens its inner strength through meditation.

cards.name: Dedenne

attacks.name: Second Bite
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It's small and its electricity-generating organ is not fully developed, so it uses its tail to absorb electricity from people's homes and charge itself.

cards.name: Charcadet

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

cards.name: Maschiff

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.

cards.name: Sprigatito
cards.flavorText: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

cards.name: Clauncher
cards.flavorText: Clauncher's claws will regrow if they fall off. The meat inside the claws is edible, but it has a distinct flavor that doesn't appeal to all tastes.

cards.name: Spidops ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Trap Territory
abilities.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost is Colorless more.

attacks.name: Wire Hang
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

cards.flavorText: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread's strength is the topic of ongoing research.

cards.name: Toedscool

attacks.name: Furious Kicks
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

cards.name: Fidough

attacks.name: Springy
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough's breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon's vicinity.

cards.name: Spidops ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Trap Territory
abilities.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost is Colorless more.

attacks.name: Wire Hang
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

cards.flavorText: No matter how much it stuffs its belly with food, it is always anxious about getting hungry again. So, it stashes berries in its cheeks and tail.

cards.name: Great Tusk ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Bedrock Breaker
attacks.text: Discard a Stadium in play.

attacks.name: Gigantic Tusks
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.

cards.name: Jacq
rules: Search your deck for up to 2 Evolution Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Rare Candy
rules: Choose 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. If you have a Stage 2 card in your hand that evolves from that Pokémon, put that card onto the Basic Pokémon to evolve it, skipping the Stage 1. You can't use this card during your first turn or on a Basic Pokémon that was put into play this turn.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

cards.name: Dragapult

attacks.name: Dragon Launcher
attacks.text: Discard a number of your Benched Dreepy up to the number of your opponent's Pokémon in play. Then, for each Dreepy you discarded in this way, choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and do 100 damage to it. You can't choose the same Pokémon more than once. This damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

cards.flavorText: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

cards.name: Reuniclus

abilities.name: Persistent Cells
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, put it into your hand instead of the discard pile. (Discard all attached cards.)

attacks.name: Cell Fork
attacks.text: Choose 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and put 3 damage counters on each of them.

cards.flavorText: While it could use its psychic abilities in battle, this Pokémon prefers to swing its powerful arms around to beat opponents into submission.

cards.name: Krookodile

abilities.name: Bully of the Sands
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may discard a random card from your opponent's hand. If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, you may discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Double-Edge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sands. Krookodile's mighty jaws can bite through heavy plates of iron with almost no effort at all.

cards.name: Medicham

abilities.name: Chakra Awakening
abilities.text: If you have exactly 4 cards in your hand, this Pokémon's attacks cost ColorlessColorlessColorless less.

attacks.name: Vigorous Kick
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Pokémon VMAX in play, this attack does 90 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's next move.

cards.name: Hisuian Lilligant

attacks.name: Swelling Scent
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Grass Energy cards and attach them to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

cards.name: Hisuian Braviary

attacks.name: Eerie Cry
attacks.text: Put 3 damage counters on each of your opponent's Pokémon that has any damage counters on it.

attacks.name: Mind Bend
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.

cards.name: Mismagius

abilities.name: Spiteful Magic
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has full HP and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, put 8 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

attacks.name: Eerie Voice
attacks.text: Put 2 damage counters on each of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its muttered curses can cause awful headaches or terrifying visions that torment others.

cards.name: Armaldo

attacks.name: Reaping Claw
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has 100 HP or less remaining, it is Knocked Out.

cards.flavorText: After evolution, this Pokémon emerged onto land. Its lower body has become stronger, and blows from its tail are devastating.

cards.name: Amoonguss

abilities.name: Surprise Spores
abilities.text: During your opponent's turn, if this Pokémon is discarded from your hand by an effect of an attack or Ability from your opponent's Pokémon, or by an effect of your opponent's Item or Supporter cards, discard your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Hypno Hammer
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon puffs poisonous spores at its foes. If the spores aren't washed off quickly, they'll grow into mushrooms wherever they land.

cards.name: Palossand

attacks.name: Sandpot Trap
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Palossand is known as the Beach Nightmare. It pulls its prey down into the sand by controlling the sand itself, and then it sucks out their souls.

cards.name: Brandon
rules: You can use this card only when it is the last card in your hand. Draw a card for each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Professor Laventon
rules: Put up to 3 Pokémon that have "Hisuian" in their names from your discard pile into your hand.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Furisode Girl
rules: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. You may switch that Pokémon with your Active Pokémon.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Metang

attacks.name: Bullet Punch
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Two Beldum have become stuck together via their own magnetic forces. With two brains, the resulting Metang has doubled psychic powers.

cards.name: Venomoth

attacks.name: Miracle Powder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose a Special Condition. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now affected by that Special Condition.

cards.flavorText: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.

cards.name: Krokorok

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Krokorok has specialized eyes that enable it to see in the dark. This ability lets Krokorok hunt in the dead of night without getting lost.

cards.name: Kirlia

abilities.name: Refinement
abilities.text: You must discard a card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw 2 cards.

cards.flavorText: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

cards.name: Quad Stone
rules:
You may use 4 Quad Stone cards at once.
• If you used 1 card, heal 10 damage from your Active Pokémon.
• If you used 4 cards, heal all damage from each of your Pokémon. (This effect works one time for 4 cards.)
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

cards.name: Lanturn

attacks.name: Strong Volt
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.

cards.name: Ninetales

attacks.name: Hypnotic Gaze
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Scorching Breath
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

cards.flavorText: It is said to live 1,000 years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.

cards.name: Drowzee

attacks.name: Hypnotic Ray
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It puts its prey to sleep and devours their dreams. It seems that bad dreams taste sour, so Drowzee doesn't particularly like eating them.

cards.name: Baltoy

attacks.name: Find a Friend
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.

cards.name: Hawlucha

attacks.name: Allure
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Acrobatics
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It drives its opponents to exhaustion with its agile maneuvers, then ends the fight with a flashy finishing move.

cards.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Pika Strike
attacks.text: If 1 of your Dedenne used Dede-Short during your last turn, this attack does 180 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

cards.name: Rotom

attacks.name: Overhaul
attacks.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 6 cards.

cards.flavorText: One boy's invention led to the development of many different machines that take advantage of Rotom's unique capabilities.

cards.name: Chimecho

attacks.name: Dreaming Tone
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if an Energy card is attached to the Defending Pokémon from your opponent's hand, that Pokémon will be Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.

cards.name: Dratini

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Dratini dwells near bodies of rapidly flowing water, such as the plunge pools of waterfalls. As it grows, Dratini will shed its skin many times.

cards.name: Ralts

attacks.name: Memory Skip
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't use that attack.

cards.flavorText: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

cards.name: Serperior V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Noble Light
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from each Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

cards.name: Ho-Oh V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Reviving Flame
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in your discard pile, you may put it onto your Bench. If you do, attach up to 4 basic Energy cards from your discard pile to this Pokémon. If you use this Ability, your turn ends.

attacks.name: Rainbow Burn
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each type of basic Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.name: Mawile VSTAR
rules: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Star Rondo
abilities.text: During your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may switch it with your Active Pokémon. If you do, switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)

attacks.name: Sudden Eater
attacks.text: If this Pokémon moved from your Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does 90 more damage.

cards.name: Radiant Jirachi
rules: Radiant Pokémon Rule: You can't have more than 1 Radiant Pokémon in your deck.

abilities.name: Entrusted Wishes
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, search your deck for up to 3 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Astral Misfortune
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is Knocked Out.

cards.flavorText: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

cards.name: Regieleki VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Transistor
abilities.text: Your Basic Lightning Pokémon's attacks do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Max Thunder and Lightning
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

cards.name: Wallace
rules: Draw 3 cards. Your opponent may draw a card. If they do, draw 1 more card.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Mawile V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Pouty Slap
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Chomp Down
attacks.text: Discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

cards.name: Magearna V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Gear Throw
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Special Laser
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Special Energy attached, this attack does 120 more damage.

cards.name: Brandon
rules: You can use this card only when it is the last card in your hand. Draw a card for each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Leafy Camo Poncho
rules: Whenever your opponent plays a Supporter card from their hand, prevent all effects of that card done to the Pokémon VSTAR or Pokémon VMAX this card is attached to.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

cards.name: Vileplume

attacks.name: Mega Drain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Allergy Storm
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Supporter cards from their hand. If tails, during your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Item cards from their hand.

cards.flavorText: It has the world's largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

cards.name: Chandelure

abilities.name: Mountain Roasting
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may discard the top 3 cards of your opponent's deck.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon haunts dilapidated mansions. It sways its arms to hypnotize opponents with the ominous dancing of its flames.

cards.name: Darkrai

attacks.name: Nightmare
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Pitch-Black Blade
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

cards.flavorText: On a moonless night, a strange incident occurred in which every one of a village's inhabitants suffered nightmares. The villagers attested that Darkrai appeared before them in these nightmares.

cards.name: Glastrier

attacks.name: Freeze Down
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, it can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Wild Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It's also a belligerent Pokémon—anything it wants, it takes by force.

cards.name: Beautifly

abilities.name: Stoked Straw
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Mega Drain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey's fluids.

cards.name: Kingdra

abilities.name: Seething Currents
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may have either player shuffle their hand and put it on the bottom of their deck. If that player put any cards on the bottom of their deck in this way, they draw 4 cards.

cards.flavorText: With the arrival of a storm at sea, this Pokémon will show itself on the surface. When a Kingdra and a Dragonite meet, a fierce battle ensues.

cards.name: Parasect

abilities.name: Lethargy Spores
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may make both Active Pokémon Asleep and Poisoned.

attacks.name: X-Scissor
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 50 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroom on its back having become the main body. If the mushroom comes off, the bug stops moving.

cards.name: Poliwrath

attacks.name: Split Spiral Punch
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Splash Loop
attacks.text: Put 2 Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand.

cards.flavorText: Its body is solid muscle. When swimming through cold seas, Poliwrath uses its impressive arms to smash through drift ice and plow forward.

cards.name: Gliscor

attacks.name: Hurricane Shock
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads. If at least 2 of them are heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey... Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

cards.name: Dustox

attacks.name: Nadir Powder
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused and Poisoned. During Pokémon Checkup, put 8 damage counters on that Pokémon instead of 1.

cards.flavorText: Tends to be drawn to bonfires on dark nights. Difficult to chase away from settlements because of the way it scatters highly toxic scales.

cards.name: Mr. Mime

attacks.name: Tricky Slap
attacks.text: You and your opponent play Rock-Paper-Scissors until someone wins. If you win, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The behavior of this clown-like Pokémon reminds one of pantomime. It creates invisible walls using a force emitted from its fingertips.

cards.name: Cramorant

abilities.name: Lost Provisions
abilities.text: If you have 4 or more cards in the Lost Zone, ignore all Energy in this Pokémon's attack costs.

attacks.name: Spit Innocently
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness.

cards.flavorText: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

cards.name: Seadra

attacks.name: Swim Freely
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hydro Jet
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It's the males that raise the offspring. While Seadra are raising young, the spines on their backs secrete thicker and stronger poison.

cards.name: Lost City
rules: Whenever a Pokémon (either yours or your opponent's) is Knocked Out, put that Pokémon in the Lost Zone instead of the discard pile. (Discard all attached cards.)

cards.name: Poliwhirl

attacks.name: Double Smash
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Staring at the swirl on its belly causes drowsiness. This trait of Poliwhirl's has been used in place of lullabies to get children to go to sleep.

cards.name: Gloom

attacks.name: Absorb
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.

cards.name: Lampent

attacks.name: Flickering Glow
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon appears just before someone passes away, so it's feared as an emissary of death.

cards.name: Damage Pump
rules: Move up to 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon to your other Pokémon in any way you like.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

cards.name: Hariyama

attacks.name: Shove
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Muscular Slap
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

cards.flavorText: Hariyama that are big and fat aren't necessarily strong. There are some small ones that move nimbly and use moves skillfully.

cards.name: Seviper

attacks.name: Sucker Punch and Turn
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Darkness Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Constant polishing makes the edge of the blade on its tail extremely sharp. It's Zangoose's archrival.

cards.name: Thorton
rules: Choose a Basic Pokémon in your discard pile and switch it with 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. Any attached cards, damage counters, Special Conditions, turns in play, and any other effects remain on the new Pokémon.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Colress's Experiment
rules: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck and put 3 of them into your hand. Put the other cards in the Lost Zone.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Seel
cards.flavorText: Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don't bother it at all, but it gets tired pretty easily in warm waters.

cards.name: Porygon

attacks.name: Branch Calculation
attacks.text: Look at the top 4 cards of either player's deck and put them back in any order.

cards.flavorText: State-of-the-art technology was used to create Porygon. It was the first artificial Pokémon to be created via computer programming.

cards.name: Oddish
cards.flavorText: If exposed to moonlight, it starts to move. It roams far and wide at night to scatter its seeds.

cards.name: Paras

attacks.name: Absorb
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are controlling the bug. Even if the bug bugs the mushrooms, they tell it to bug off.

cards.name: Blipbug
cards.flavorText: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn't.

cards.name: Litwick

attacks.name: Kindling Panic
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

cards.flavorText: The flame on its head keeps its body slightly warm. This Pokémon takes lost children by the hand to guide them to the spirit world.

cards.name: Finneon

abilities.name: Oceanic Accompaniment
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a Water Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon that has the Swim Freely attack.

cards.flavorText: It lures in prey with its shining tail fins. It stays near the surface during the day and moves to the depths when night falls.

cards.name: Delphox V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Eerie Glow
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned and Confused.

attacks.name: Magical Fire
attacks.text: Put 2 Energy attached to this Pokémon in the Lost Zone. This attack also does 120 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Kyurem V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Rapid Freeze
attacks.text: Attach any number of Water Energy cards from your hand to your Pokémon in any way you like.

cards.name: Kyurem VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Glaciated World
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may discard the top card of your deck. If that card is a Water Energy card, attach it to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Max Frost
attacks.text: You may discard any amount of Water Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 50 more damage for each card you discarded in this way.

cards.name: Hisuian Zoroark VSTAR
rules: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Phantom Star
abilities.text: During your turn, you may discard your hand and draw 7 cards. (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)

attacks.name: Ticking Curse
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage for each of your Pokémon that has any damage counters on it.

cards.name: Radiant Steelix
rules: Radiant Pokémon Rule: You can't have more than 1 Radiant Pokémon in your deck.

attacks.name: Energy Stream
attacks.text: Attach up to 2 Metal Energy cards from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Destructive Finish
attacks.text: Discard cards from the top of your deck until only 1 card remains. This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy card you discarded in this way.

cards.flavorText: It is said that if an Onix lives for over 100 years, its composition changes to become diamond-like.

cards.name: Arezu
rules: Search your deck for up to 3 Evolution Pokémon that don't have a Rule Box, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. (Pokémon V, Pokémon-GX, etc. have Rule Boxes.)
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Drapion V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Wild Style
abilities.text: This Pokémon's attacks cost Colorless less for each of your opponent's Single Strike, Rapid Strike, and Fusion Strike Pokémon in play.

attacks.name: Dynamic Tail
attacks.text: This attack also does 60 damage to 1 of your Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Rotom V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Instant Charge
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may draw 3 cards. If you use this Ability, your turn ends.

attacks.name: Scrap Short
attacks.text: Put any number of Pokémon Tool cards from your discard pile in the Lost Zone. This attack does 40 more damage for each card you put in the Lost Zone in this way.

cards.name: Drapion VSTAR
rules: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Hazard Star
abilities.text: During your turn, you may make your opponent's Active Pokémon Paralyzed and Poisoned. During Pokémon Checkup, put 3 damage counters on that Pokémon instead of 1. (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)

attacks.name: Big Bang Arm
attacks.text: This attack does 10 less damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

cards.name: Arezu
rules: Search your deck for up to 3 Evolution Pokémon that don't have a Rule Box, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. (Pokémon V, Pokémon-GX, etc. have Rule Boxes.)
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Dark Patch
rules: Attach a basic Darkness Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Darkness Pokémon.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

cards.name: Hisuian Lilligant

attacks.name: Twister Lutz
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

cards.name: Keldeo

attacks.name: Line Force
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.

cards.name: Kleavor

attacks.name: Timber Cleave
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is Knocked Out.

attacks.name: Berserker Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

cards.name: Hisuian Decidueye

attacks.name: Piercing Claw
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Direct Arrow
attacks.text: This attack does 80 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui's extreme cold. This is firm proof that evolution can be influenced by environment.

cards.name: Hisuian Typhlosion

abilities.name: Supernatural Orb
abilities.text: You must discard a Psychic Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may make your opponent's Active Pokémon Burned and Confused.

attacks.name: Shadow Bind
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

cards.flavorText: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.

cards.name: Ursaluna

attacks.name: Peat Hunt
attacks.text: Put up to 2 cards from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Bulky Bump
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

cards.name: Mismagius

attacks.name: Ominous Prose
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand. If they have 4 or more cards in their hand, choose all but 3, and your opponent shuffles the chosen cards into their deck.

attacks.name: Psybeam
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Its muttered curses can cause awful headaches or terrifying visions that torment others.

cards.name: Hisuian Overqwil

attacks.name: Dirty Press
attacks.text: If you have at least 3 Darkness Energy in play, this attack does 90 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname "sea fiend." It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

cards.name: Glaceon

attacks.name: Frost Wall
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Evolution Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Glaceon is able to lower its body temperature very quickly. It freezes the atmosphere, creating diamond dust that glitters like gems while it flutters and dances around.

cards.name: Shaymin

attacks.name: Encouraging Gift
attacks.text: You can use this attack only if you go second, and only during your first turn. Search your deck for up to 3 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: When the turning of seasons brings the cruel winter to its end and the joyous people give thanks to the heavens, Shaymin appears and covers the withered land with flowers.

cards.name: Togetic

abilities.name: Voice of Happiness
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may heal 30 damage from your Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

cards.name: Piloswine

attacks.name: Blizzard
attacks.text: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.

cards.name: Golduck

attacks.name: Entangled Dive
attacks.text: Discard each player's Active Pokémon and all attached cards. (You choose a new Active Pokémon first.)

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in gently flowing rivers. It paddles through the water with its long limbs, putting its graceful swimming skills on display.

cards.name: Ursaring

attacks.name: Continuous Slap
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: When the cold season arrives in Hisui, this Pokémon will wander fields and mountains alike in search of its favorite berries. Ursaring's hunger during this time makes it a ferocious danger.

cards.name: Hippowdon

attacks.name: Sand Breath
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Stones can get stuck in the ports on their bodies. Dwebble help dislodge such stones, so Hippowdon look after these Pokémon.

cards.name: Magneton

attacks.name: Bounce Back
attacks.text: Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is three Magnemite that have linked together. Magneton sends out powerful radio waves to study its surroundings.

cards.name: Dartrix
cards.flavorText: Regularly basks in sunlight to gather power—presumably due to the frigid climate. Nonetheless, the edges of the blade quills set into its wings are keen as ever.

cards.name: Temple of Sinnoh
rules: All Special Energy attached to Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) provide Colorless Energy and have no other effect.

cards.name: Gapejaw Bog
rules: Whenever either player puts a Basic Pokémon from their hand onto their Bench, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.

cards.name: Trekking Shoes
rules: Look at the top card of your deck. You may put that card into your hand. If you don't, discard that card and draw a card.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

cards.name: Kricketot

attacks.name: Trip Over
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.

cards.name: Cyndaquil

attacks.name: Charge Energy
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Hails from the Johto region. Though usually curled into a ball due to its timid disposition, it harbors tremendous firepower.

cards.name: Drifloon

attacks.name: Triple Spin
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Said to lure away young children and carry them off to the afterlife. Some whisper that Drifloon are formed of reincarnated human souls, but these rumors are as yet unconfirmed.

cards.name: Eevee

abilities.name: Resonant Evolution
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play a Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your other Eevee, you may search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

cards.name: Togepi

abilities.name: Touch of Happiness
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may heal 10 damage from your Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This ovate creature is frequently mistaken for a moving egg when encountered out in the fields or in the mountains. Its guileless smile soothes the soul.

cards.name: Nickit
cards.flavorText: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

cards.name: Yanma
cards.flavorText: Its frail wings are so thin that one can see clear through them. However, during flight these wings exhibit the power to churn air with force enough to launch a house skyward.

cards.name: Kleavor V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Axe Slash
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Beedrill V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Twineedle
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Swarming Sting
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon for each of your Beedrill V in play. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Oranguru V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Back Order
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may search your deck for up to 2 Pokémon Tool cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Hisuian Lilligant VSTAR

cards.flavorText: Known as the Drill King, this Pokémon can tunnel through the terrain at speeds of over 90 mph.

cards.name: Galarian Linoone

cards.name: Simisage

cards.name: Primeape

attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon V, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.name: Garbodor

attacks.name: Poison Gas

cards.flavorText: The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can kill a weakened creature instantly.

cards.flavorText: It's good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It's kind enough to share them with friends.

cards.name: Jigglypuff

attacks.name: Let's All Rollout

cards.flavorText: The songs they sing are totally different depending on the region they live in. Some even sound like they're shouting!

cards.name: Clauncher
cards.flavorText: It moves around by jetting water from its right pincer. It has a poor sense of balance, so it's terrible at swimming straight.

cards.name: Shelmet
cards.flavorText: It has a strange physiology that responds to electricity. When together with Karrablast, Shelmet evolves for some reason.

cards.name: Phantump
cards.flavorText: With a voice like a human child's, it cries out to lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost among the trees.

cards.name: Sizzlipede

attacks.name: Singe
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they're well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.

cards.flavorText: Extremely loyal, it will fearlessly bark at any opponent to protect its own Trainer from harm.

cards.name: Panpour

cards.name: Jynx

attacks.name: Dazzle Dance

cards.flavorText: This vicious Pokémon sprays a poisonous liquid on opponents that come near. For whatever reason, it gets along really well with Dhelmise.

cards.name: Entei

cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

attacks.name: Poison Tentacles

cards.flavorText: Normally, it lived on shallow sea shoals. When the tide went out, this Pokémon came up on land to search for prey.

cards.name: Crabominable

attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Water Energy attached to it, this attack does 80 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It stores coldness in its pincers and pummels its foes. It can even smash thick walls of ice to bits!

cards.name: Alolan Sandslash

attacks.name: Reinforced Needle

cards.flavorText: It runs across snow-covered plains at high speeds. It developed thick, sharp claws to plow through the snow.

cards.name: Glalie

attacks.name: Ice Fang

attacks.name: Frosty Typhoon
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Frosty Typhoon during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: It freezes its prey and chews them whole. However, it prefers to eat Pokémon like Vanillite that are already frozen.

cards.name: Tangrowth

attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 80 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Zangoose

attacks.name: Brutal Edge
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It has feuded with Seviper for many generations. Its sharp claws are its biggest weapons.

cards.name: Lileep

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: In ancient times, it lived in warm seas. It disguised itself as seaweed to ambush its prey and devoured them whole when they got close.

attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 100 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.

cards.name: Pignite
cards.flavorText: The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. This fills it with even more power.

cards.name: Togedemaru

attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: When it's surprised or agitated, the 14 fur spikes on its back will stand up involuntarily.

attacks.name: Air Slash
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: A Pokémon weapon developed for a specific mission, it went berserk during an experiment, so it was cryogenically frozen.

cards.name: Vibrava

abilities.name: Obnoxious Whirring
abilities.text: Whenever your opponent plays a Supporter card from their hand, prevent all effects of that card done to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It vibrates its wings to generate ultrasonic waves, causing its prey to faint. Then it buries the prey alive in the sand to preserve it.

rules: Play this card as if it were a 30-HP Colorless Basic Pokémon. At any time during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, you may discard all cards from it and put it on the bottom of your deck.
This card can't retreat. If this card is Knocked Out, your opponent can't take any Prize cards for it.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Roxie
rules: Discard up to 2 Pokémon that aren't Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX from your hand. Draw 3 cards for each card you discarded in this way.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Kricketot

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

cards.flavorText: It chats with others using the sounds of its colliding antennae. These sounds are fall hallmarks.

cards.name: Litleo
cards.flavorText: When they're young, they live with a pride. Once they're able to hunt prey on their own, they're kicked out and have to make their own way.

cards.name: Spheal
cards.flavorText: They can't swim well yet, and they move much faster by rolling. When they're happy, they clap fins.

cards.name: Pancham
cards.flavorText: It follows Pangoro around like a henchman. When Pancham makes a big mistake, its leaf gets taken away.

cards.name: Phantump
cards.flavorText: By imitating the voice of a child, it causes people to get hopelessly lost deep in the forest. It's trying to make friends with them.

cards.name: Slugma

attacks.name: Singe
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

cards.name: Flabébé

attacks.name: Floral Invitation
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Fairy Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It's not safe without the power of a flower, but it will keep traveling around until it finds one with the color and shape it wants.

cards.name: Palpitoad

attacks.name: Mini Earthquake
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

cards.name: Azurill

cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that lives by water. It moves quickly on land by bouncing on its big tail.

abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in play, it is Psychic and Fighting type.

attacks.text: Move an Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Because it can sense what its foe is thinking, its attacks burst out first, fast, and fierce.

cards.name: Flygon-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Dusty Defense
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, all of your Pokémon take 30 less damage from your opponent's attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.text: If there is any Stadium card in play, this attack does 120 more damage. Then, discard that Stadium card.

attacks.name: Sonic Edge-GX
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Magnezone

abilities.name: Double Type
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in play, it is Lightning and Metal type.

attacks.name: Magnetic Bolt
attacks.text: Put a Trainer card from your discard pile into your hand.

cards.flavorText: It uses radar to monitor its territory. Intruders are quickly disposed of with a hyper beam.

cards.name: Giratina

abilities.name: Dimension Breach
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may discard a Special Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Fade to Black
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange.

cards.name: Celebi

attacks.name: Time Spiral
attacks.text: Devolve 1 of your opponent's evolved Pokémon by removing the highest Stage Evolution card from it. Your opponent shuffles that card into their deck.

attacks.name: Mind Bend
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

cards.name: Haxorus

abilities.name: Grind Up
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard any Stadium card in play. If you do, attach up to 3 in any combination of Fire and Metal Energy cards from your hand to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Powerful Axe
attacks.text: This attack does 40 more damage times the amount of basic Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.

cards.name: Silvally

attacks.name: Avenging Heart
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each Prize card your opponent took on their last turn.

attacks.name: Air Slash
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This is its form once it has awakened and evolved. Freed from its heavy mask, its speed is greatly increased.

cards.name: Abomasnow

attacks.name: Quick Freeze
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has any Water Energy attached to it, it is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Wild Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It blankets wide areas in snow by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as "The Ice Monster."

cards.name: Whimsicott

abilities.name: Prowl
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: This nuisance sneaks into people's homes, where it hides important things and scatters cotton all over the place.

cards.name: Magmortar

attacks.name: Smoke Bomb
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn't happen.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: There are still quite a few factories that rely on the flames provided by Magmortar to process metals.

cards.name: Excadrill

attacks.name: Rototiller
attacks.text: Shuffle 4 cards from your discard pile into your deck.

cards.flavorText: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

cards.name: Araquanid

attacks.name: Tangle Drag
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sticky Web
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks cost Colorless more, and its Retreat Cost is Colorless more.

cards.flavorText: It usually passes its time in the water. When its belly is full, it stores its subdued prey in the water bubble on its head.

cards.name: Talonflame

attacks.name: Heat Wave
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Flare Raid
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Its tough wings don't allow fire to pass through them. A long time ago, firefighters' outfits were made from Talonflame wings.

cards.name: Tapu Fini

attacks.name: Nature Wave
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Ultra Beasts in play, this attack can be used for Colorless.

cards.flavorText: This guardian deity of Poni Island manipulates water. Because it lives deep within a thick fog, it came to be both feared and revered.

cards.name: Toxapex
cards.flavorText: To attack, this Pokémon sends toxic spikes flying at its enemies. Ones that come close get mown down by the claws on its feet.

cards.name: Pyukumuku

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

cards.flavorText: The tradition known as Pyukumuku chucking started from the custom of throwing Pyukumuku back into the sea after they wash onshore.

cards.name: Breloom

attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Pre-Dawn Strike
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Asleep, this attack does 90 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

cards.name: Reset Stamp

You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Lampent

attacks.name: Fireworks
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

cards.name: Steenee

attacks.name: Double Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It's protected by its hard sepals, so it plays with bird Pokémon without worry. They peck it relentlessly, but it doesn't care.

cards.name: Weakness Guard Energy

The Pokémon this card is attached to has no Weakness.

cards.name: Tauros

attacks.name: Call for Family

attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Snooze
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It stays asleep from the moment it's born. When it falls into a deep sleep, it stops moving altogether.

cards.flavorText: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

cards.name: Sableye

attacks.name: Mirror Gem

cards.flavorText: It digs through the ground with its hard claws and crunches down gems with its thick pointy teeth. Carbink is its favorite food.

cards.name: Cresselia

attacks.name: Aurora Gain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Luminous Blade
attacks.text: Discard a Psychic Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

cards.name: Dragonair

attacks.name: Destructive Whirlpool
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Lakes where Dragonair live are filled with offerings from people, because they believe this Pokémon is able to control the weather.

cards.name: Foongus

attacks.name: Spore
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.

cards.name: Fletchinder

attacks.name: Flame Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Fire Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It scatters embers in the tall grass. Then bug Pokémon, frightened by the flames, come flying out, and Fletchinder gobbles them up.

cards.name: Tynamo

attacks.name: Wild River
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

cards.name: Druddigon

attacks.name: Drag Off
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to the new Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dragon Tail
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 100 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: The red skin on its face is harder than rock. In narrow caves, it squares off against its enemies and charges face-first right into them.

cards.name: Magnemite

attacks.name: Supersonic
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: It's frequently the cause of power outages, which is why some power plants send out electrical signals that it can't stand.

cards.name: Scraggy

attacks.name: Swagger
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: They move in small groups, walking around lazily. Anyone who makes eye contact gets smacked with a headbutt.

cards.name: Numel

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: It knows how people and Pokémon feel by looking at their auras. It doesn't approach dangerous opponents.

attacks.name: High-Heat Blast
attacks.text: If you have at least 4 Fire Energy in play, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

cards.name: Marshadow

abilities.name: Resetting Hole
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may discard any Stadium card in play. If you do, discard this Pokémon and all cards attached to it.

attacks.name: Red Knuckles
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Ultra Beast, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It slips into the shadows of others and mimics their powers and movements. As it improves, it becomes stronger than those it's imitating.

cards.name: Kyurem

attacks.name: Call Forth Cold
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Water Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Hail Prison
attacks.text: Discard 2 Water Energy from this Pokémon. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

cards.name: Lucario

attacks.name: Rush Up
attacks.text: If you attached a Pokémon Tool card from your hand to this Pokémon during this turn, this attack does 70 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It concentrates its mental energy and fires off mysterious waves called auras, which can crush boulders of large size to dust.

cards.name: Malamar

attacks.name: Hypnotic Reign
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand. You may discard a Pokémon you find there and use one of that Pokémon's non-GX attacks as this attack.

attacks.name: Dark Pressure
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

cards.flavorText: When it comes to strong hypnosis, there's an endless number of people who utilize Malamar for their nefarious deeds.

cards.name: Slowbro

attacks.name: Yawn
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Three Strikes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 100 damage for each heads. If all of them are tails, you lose this game.

cards.flavorText: Spacing out is basically all it does. It turns back into Slowpoke if its tail, along with Shellder, breaks off.

cards.name: Krookodile

attacks.name: Chomp Chomp Panic
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: When it spots prey, even at a distance of over 30 miles, it swims through the desert as if it were water, then jumps out and chomps them.

cards.name: Blacephalon

attacks.name: Blazer
